paras: Anolis lynchi, also known commonly as Lynch's anole and el cameleón sudamericano de Lynch in South American Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae. The species is native to northwestern South America.
The specific name, lynchi, is in honor of American herpetologist John Douglas Lynch.
Anolis lynchi is found in southwestern Colombia and adjacent northwestern Ecuador.
The preferred natural habitat of Anolis lynchi is forest, at altitudes around 600 m (2,000 ft).
Anolis lynchi is a member of the Anolis auratus species group.
